summary: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd, a Nasdaq-listed (NCT) Singapore-domiciled freight company, filed a Form 6-K reporting that on September 10, 2026 it mutually terminated a June 4, 2026 Subscription Agreement with Beverly Holding Limited, a BVI entity wholly owned by CEO Muchun Zhu, which had covered 650,000 Class B shares at US$3.00 per share (US$1,950,000); no closing had occurred. Concurrently, on September 7, 2026 the parties signed a replacement subscription for 1,625,000 Class B shares at US$0.40 per share (US$650,000), approved by the Audit Committee. Watch related-party dilution and pricing reset risk.
